purpose: Freeze the local interfaces and governance boundary for prospective owner-decision instrumentation and an exact offline OPRA CMBP catalogue preflight. This contract does not adopt or evaluate a trading policy.

job49_may_claim: append-only human-decision instrumentation is locally ready when its synthetic gate passes
an exact CMBP catalogue request and response contract is locally ready when its offline gate passes
the completed selected-symbol CMBP fixture is reusable as parser-semantic evidence only
job49_must_not_claim: Databento availability, entitlement, coverage, exact free boundary, exact eligible-session count, or total cost
unbiased event prevalence or population representativeness from the selected 64-session fixture
human predictability, signal efficacy, model skill, causal lead, fillability, expected return, or P&L
shadow, paper, live, or real-money readiness
claim_boundary.reason_alpha_is_zero: The authorized work reads no strategy outcome and performs no fit, threshold choice, policy selection, fill replay, or economic evaluation.

forbidden: vendor or Databento call of any kind

immutability.semantic_change_rule: V1 may be repaired until self_hash.status is SEALED. After sealing, any change to authority, actions, risk, gate logic, statuses, scope, or future-job ordering requires PROGRAM_CONTRACT_V2.json or later.
immutability.pending_self_hash_is_not_authority: A temporarily null self_hash means the local integration writer has not sealed the contract yet. It is not a waiver of versioning, receipt, or hash checks.
immutability.receipt_binding_required: LOCAL_FOUNDATION_RECEIPT_V1.json must include the verified program contract self-hash, the raw-byte plan SHA-256, and hashes of the exact implementation, tests, fixture identities, and scope manifest it exercised.

missingness_semantics.MONITORING_OFF: The owner is outside the monitored decision risk set; this is not WAIT.
missingness_semantics.unanswered_prompt: A prompt without a linked DECISION is missing, not WAIT.
missingness_semantics.missing_event: Silence or a capture gap is never converted into WAIT.

clock_law.appended_at_source: The production CLI generates appended_at from its current UTC clock; deterministic test injection is test-only.

human_policy_record_contract_v1.correction_semantics: A correction is an annotation-only backward link. It never changes the original decision, action count, position state, or training label.

negative_label_law.future_real_capture_requirement: Freeze an exogenous prompt schedule or other risk-set law before the first real record.

append_only_law.correction_mechanism: Append a CORRECTION event whose corrects_event_id links to the sealed superseded event.
append_only_law.record_hash_procedure: Remove record_hash, serialize with json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False), hash the UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256, then store the lowercase hexadecimal digest. The next event carries that digest as previous_hash.
append_only_law.tail_rollback_law: A finalized journal terminal sequence and head must be independently bound in a receipt; rollback is detected by comparison with that anchor. The bare chain alone proves only the records still present.

forbidden_record_content: post-outcome annotation disguised as contemporaneous intent

declared_stop.plain_language: The stop must be -40% or wider, meaning -40% or a more negative fraction; a tighter stop is invalid.

risk_contract_v1.logger_behavior: The Job 49 logger freezes and validates the presence/identity of this risk metadata. It does not simulate tickets, serial equity, breaker firing, stops, survival, fills, or economics.

H_human_instrumentation.question: Can a local logger record prospective owner-intent events under the exact event/action vocabulary as an append-only, causally timestamped chain while freezing v1 risk metadata and containing no outcome field or external dependency?

C_offline_cmbp_catalogue.question: Can an exact, deterministic per-session OPRA CMBP catalogue request law and offline response-artifact validator be frozen and tested with no vendor-client construction or call path?

frozen_request_semantics.symbol_scope: unique sorted 21-character raw SPXW OSI symbols from each existing plus-or-minus-25-point same-day-expiry band

method_shapes.symbology.resolve: One session, exact raw-symbol list, stype_in raw_symbol, and exact session date bounds.
method_shapes.metadata.get_cost: One session, OPRA.PILLAR, cmbp-1, exact raw-symbol list, and exact half-open RTH bounds.

frozen_request_semantics.cost_total_law: Sum finite per-session vendor values; never extrapolate a sample mean.

selected_semantic_fixture.permitted_inference: parser and strict-prior-touch semantic possibility only

local_integration_receipt_contract_v1.receipt_hash_procedure: Remove receipt_sha256, canonicalize, and SHA-256 hash the bytes.
local_integration_receipt_contract_v1.failure_law: Refuse the pass receipt and emit a named STOP_LOCAL_RECEIPT_INVALID diagnostic; never repair, widen, or retry external work.

job49_terminal_law.any_evidence_gate_stop: Preserve the named STOP receipt and end Job 49 without widening scope or silently retrying.

self_hash.procedure: Parse this file as strict JSON, copy the complete object, set copied self_hash.value to null and copied self_hash.status to NORMALIZED_FOR_HASH, serialize the copy with json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False), hash the UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256, then store the lowercase digest and set stored self_hash.status to SEALED. Verification repeats the same normalization, so changing the stored status from UNSEALED to SEALED cannot change the semantic digest.
